description: This is a false-colour infrared satellite image depicting an area of managed arable land, consistent with non-irrigated agricultural fields. The image features a dense mosaic of irregularly shaped and rectangular agricultural parcels, predominantly coloured in deep red, indicating healthy vegetation as typically seen in false-colour infrared representations. The individual fields are clearly delineated by thin, lighter greenish-teal lines, which represent field boundaries, uncultivated strips, or possibly tracks. Scattered within the fields are small, isolated patches of brighter, light green or white, suggesting specific non-vegetated features such as small structures or bare ground. The image shows a broad expanse of contiguous agricultural activity.
